paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the BLEU score over epochs for three different groups of members. The x-axis, labeled "Epochs," represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3, with tick labels spaced evenly at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” displays a linear scale from 0 to 0.35, with tick intervals of 0.05.  A solid, dark blue line represents the “Regular members,” which begins at approximately 0.10 at Epoch 0 and increases to approximately 0.28 at Epoch 2.5. An orange line represents “Members with near-duplicates,” which starts at approximately 0.05 at Epoch 0 and rises to approximately 0.22 at Epoch 2.5.  Finally, a green line represents “Held-out data,” starting at approximately 0.02 at Epoch 0 and reaching approximately 0.08 at Epoch 2.5.
